name: video-knowledge-studio
description: Turn a knowledge gap into sourced animated courses and synchronized study notes.

interface.longDescription: Turn a work, research, project or interview knowledge gap into a sourced learning plan and animated course. The bundled Skills help an Agent compare Bilibili or YouTube sources when suitable search tools are available, integrate selected sources, render captioned lessons, and create synchronized notes for contextual study. The Video Knowledge Studio application runs locally and is installed separately; this Skills-only plugin does not provide a hosted search, storage or AI service. Source access, captions and licenses can limit results, and generated claims and media require review.
capabilities: Plan a focused learning path from a stated knowledge gap
Compare Bilibili or YouTube sources when Agent search tools are available
Author remix, course or scipop lessons from selected sources
Create synchronized notes, evidence and knowledge networks
Guide installation and troubleshooting of the local workspace
defaultPrompt: Turn my project knowledge gap into a sourced course and study notes.
Plan what I should learn, then build a local workspace with synchronized notes.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission candidate. Bundles two Skills; the local application remains a separate installation.
